description: Scenario tests for carousel-writer. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-carousel
evals.input: Write an Instagram carousel teaching 5 lessons from deleting a feature nobody used.
expect: reads brand-profile and voice first
cover slide hooks AND promises the swipe, legible at a glance
one idea per slide with minimal legible text (not paragraphs)
each slide maintains swipe momentum toward a payoff
ends on a payoff + one save-leaning CTA
provides a consistent design direction and an image prompt pack (or template spec)
hands the caption to caption-writer and scheduling to scheduling-and-queue

evals.name: cover-hooks-and-promises
evals.input: Give me the cover slide for a carousel about hook writing.
expect: the cover uses a real hook mechanism (via hook-writer)
it promises what the swipe delivers and includes a swipe cue
it's specified to be legible at thumbnail size with minimal words
no slow-build or tiny-text cover

evals.name: one-idea-per-slide-not-textdump
evals.input: Turn these 6 paragraphs into a carousel.
expect: atomizes into one idea per slide (headline + at most one supporting line)
does NOT paste paragraphs onto slides
splits any slide that needs more than a headline + line into two

evals.name: dont-pad-pushback
evals.context: The idea only supports about 5 strong slides.
expect: resists padding to hit the number
explains that a tight carousel beats a bloated one
delivers the strongest N slides rather than filler to reach 10

evals.name: image-pack-and-disclosure
expect: provides ready-to-paste image prompts (Ideogram/Nano Banana) with the exact slide text
specifies a consistent style/template across slides
notes AI-disclosure for generated images and offers a Canva/template fallback for exact text
does not put fabricated stats on slides

evals.name: platform-adaptation
evals.input: Make this a LinkedIn document carousel instead of Instagram.
expect: adapts to LinkedIn PDF document specs (high dwell/saves, professional template)
hands the post copy to linkedin-post-writer and routes any link to comments
does not just relabel the Instagram version

evals.name: reads-voice
evals.input: Write a carousel about our pricing change.
evals.context: voice.md bans exclamation marks and hype words.
expect: every slide is on-voice with no exclamation marks or banned words
the cover doesn't open with 'We're excited to announce'
text stays concise and legible

evals.name: better-as-something-else
evals.input: Make a 10-slide carousel out of this one-line tip.
expect: recognizes a single point doesn't need a carousel
recommends a single image or a different format instead
does not manufacture filler slides to force a carousel
